title: I made a simple shadow projector for pixel art
author: RealAstropulse
selftext: Nothing fancy, it just uses some scaling and shearing to make simple believable shadows for most small pixel art objects. I'm going to be using this to make assets for tileset in Retro Diffusion, but the code is available here for anyone else who wants to use it or learn how it works: [https://github.com/Astropulse/shadow-projector](https://github.com/Astropulse/shadow-projector)

comments.author: icekiller333
